div.div:
CVA6 path (CoreType = CORE_CVA6):
- replaces RV32 core_region + OBI buffers + OBI->AXI bridges with corejack_cva6_axi_adapter
- core_axi_req[0] = cva6 native AXI; core_axi_req[1] is tied to '0; SBA path (core_axi_req[2]) is unchanged
- sim supported (cfg/cores/cva6.yaml); FPGA + debug planned
